skills.name: Burning Purgatory
skills.description: Selects the nearest or farthest enemy unit, deals AoE <c6>Burn damage</c> equal to <c2>80%</c> of attack to it and all enemy units <c2>within a 3x3 tile area</c> of it, and generates <c1>{bic}</c> for <c2>2 turns</c>. If there is a target with <c1>{bie}</c> on the battlefield, this attack prioritizes that target.

skills.name: Dipolar Predation
skills.description: At the start of the battle, applies <c2>1 stack</c> of <c1>{bie}</c> to the nearest and farthest enemy Dolls. At the end of the turn, if there are no targets afflicted with this effect, applies <c2>1 stack</c> of <c1>{bie}</c> to the nearest and farthest enemy Dolls.

skills.name: Repulsion Surge
skills.description: Deals AoE Physical damage equal to <c2>60%</c> of attack to all enemy units <c2>within 4 tiles</c> of this unit, knocks them back by <c2>2 tiles</c>, then applies <c1>{bia}</c> and <c1>{bib}</c> for <c2>2 turns</c>.

skills.name: Terminal Scorched Earth
skills.description: Marks an area <c2>outside of a 7x7 tile area</c>. At the start of this unit's action on the next turn, deals AoE <c6>Burn damage</c> equal to <c2>100%</c> of attack to all targets within the marked area and generates <c1>{bic}</c> <c2>in a 3x3 tile area</c> around the targets for <c2>2 turns</c>. If a target has <c1>{bie}</c>, cleanses all instances of <c1>{bie}</c> and deals AoE <c6>Burn damage</c> equal to <c2>60%</c> of attack.

skills.name: Snow Disaster
skills.description: Selects the enemy target with the lowest HP, deals <c3>Freeze damage</c> equal to <c2>80%</c> of attack to it, and applies <c1>{b1v}</c> for <c2>2 turns</c>.

skills.name: Mechanical Creation
skills.description: When stability index is greater than <c2>0</c>, damage taken is reduced by <c2>80%</c>. Unable to receive stability restoration effects during Stability Break. After <c2>2 turns</c> of Stability Break, fully restores stability index.

skills.name: Deep Blocker
skills.description: Immune to Control effects such as Stun, Taunt, and Command Prohibition.

skills.name: Hunting Embers
skills.description: When attacking an enemy target with <c1>{bie}</c>, performs <c2>1 instance</c> of <c1>{big}</c> against it.
